name: Enhance Mind (body)
source: Book of Magic: The Lost Spell Words
book: Book of Magic: The Lost Spell Words

facets.bk: Book of Magic: The Lost Spell Words

body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist/investigator 2, antipaladin/paladin 2, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 2, bard/skald 2, cleric/oracle/warpriest 2, druid/hunter 2, magus 2, ranger 2, shaman 2, summoner/unchained summoner 2

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level + 1 round per three levels
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Target Restrictions personal, selected

DESCRIPTION

The target of a wordspell with this effect word receives a +4 enhancement bonus to either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (caster’s choice). The target can end a wordspell with this effect word prematurely as a swift action, gaining a +8 enhancement bonus to the ability score until the end of the target’s turn.
